name: where-tokens-went
description: Local deterministic usage audit for coding-agent Harness histories

scripts.build: node scripts/build-echarts.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/write-build-manifest.js && node scripts/copy-report-styles.js
scripts.test: npm run package-skills && npm run install-skills && node --test tests/codex-inspect.test.js
scripts.test:targeted: node --test tests/p0-regressions.test.js tests/eval-contract.test.js tests/eval-lab.test.js tests/eval-optimizer.test.js tests/report-run.test.js tests/report-run-lanes.test.js tests/report-run-concurrency.test.js tests/scoped-inventory-cache.test.js
scripts.install-local: npm run package-skills && npm link && npm run install-skills
